gtin.rule: GTIN/MPN are populated only when an exact supplier/manufacturer/internal verified source exists.

compatibility.rule: Same size/title is candidate-only; hard compatibility requires exact connection/material/pressure evidence.

external_source_check.outcome: No trustworthy public GTINs were found for the audited Top-30 cohort during finalization. Family-level technical evidence exists for some Vispar valve families, but it is not promoted to exact per-SKU facts without exact mapping.

corroborated_examples.promotion_policy: family evidence only; do not overwrite exact SKU facts without exact product mapping
family evidence only; exact connection details require exact product evidence

guardrails: Stable product IDs and SKU retained as canonical identifiers.
Missing GTIN/MPN is an explicit governed unknown, not a value to infer.
Same-size/title clues remain candidate-only and are not promoted to verified compatibility.
No price, sale price, discount, coupon, stock or availability values were invented or altered.
Schema/feed parity remains 30/30 with zero hard fabrications.
final_note: Phase 9 is final at the implementation/governance layer. Source facts that cannot be verified remain explicit unknowns and do not count as unfinished implementation.
